# On the Stability and Spectral Gap of SU(N) Lattice Yang--Mills Theory

## Abstract

This document presents a unified and self-contained proof of the existence of a nonzero mass gap for Euclidean lattice Yang-Mills theory at a fixed, finite lattice spacing. The argument relies on several geometric-spectral pillars:
1.  A uniform horizontal lower bound on the Hessian of the effective action, which combines the Wilson action and the Haar measure.
2.  The Bakry--Émery curvature-dimension condition for the associated Langevin generator, which rigorously connects uniform convexity to volume-uniform Poincaré and logarithmic Sobolev inequalities, and thus to a spectral gap.
